temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin admits he is unhappy with his construction job, feels stuck and unfulfilled, is unsure how to start changing careers, and agrees to explore options with Angela.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela suspects Kevin is unhappy with his job as a construction worker and is concerned about him.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - her suspicion is confirmed and clarified.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is genuinely unhappy and unfulfilled in his job and is open to exploring career alternatives with her help.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and sympathetic, with cautious hope after he agrees to explore options.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Help Kevin explore career options and figure out a better fit for him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin thanks Angela, says he has been thinking a lot, expresses interest in something creative such as design or architecture, and agrees to look at the resources she found.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is considering a career change and is open to support.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is seriously considering a creative career change, possibly in design or architecture, and is receptive to resources.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Provide resources and continue helping Kevin explore career options.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin appreciates the meeting Angela arranged but says he is not sure he is ready; after Angela encourages him, he agrees to talk to the career coach.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is hesitant about making a career change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - hesitation is confirmed, but he also shows willingness to take a step.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is still hesitant but willing to meet with a career coach; he needs encouragement and support.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and worried before the conversation, then understanding and somewhat relieved when he agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Motivate and support Kevin through the career coach meeting and help him build confidence and a plan.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin reports that the career coach has been helpful, he has started online design courses, and he feels more confident about the change.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin is making progress in his career transition.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes - progress is confirmed and strengthened.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin is actively progressing in his design career transition and becoming more confident.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Continue checking in, supporting Kevin, and offering help when needed.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Kevin is surprised but grateful for the celebration, says Angela's support means a lot, and agrees to celebrate with her.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Angela believes Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: No substantive change - her belief is confirmed and celebrated.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Kevin has successfully transitioned to a new career and appreciates her support; it is time to celebrate his success.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Celebrate Kevin's success and enjoy the party with him.
